setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 sends to a MIDI device on OUT 1 and channel 2 to a second output, MIDI port 2 on MIDI channel 2. Each channel has its Masks defaults set so that every step sounds: channel 1 plays a low drum note, C1 (MIDI 36), at velocity 100 and channel 2 plays MIDI 72 at velocity 90, both half a step long. Channel 1's Masks screen is open. The Rate is /1 at 90 BPM, so one step lasts a sixth of a second, and playback is stopped.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap Pattern (5,8) for Pattern Trig and choose pattern 1 at (1,1). Tap steps 2, 3 and 4 off at (2,4), (3,4) and (4,4), then tap steps 5, 9 and 13 on at (5,4), (9,4) and (13,4). Pattern 1 now has trigs on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13: four hits per bar.
steps.title: Enter the drum pattern

steps.caption: Choose pattern 2 at (2,1) and tap steps 1, 3 and 4 at (1,4), (3,4) and (4,4): a figure with trigs on steps 1, 3 and 4.
steps.title: Enter the short figure

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8) and channel 1 at (1,1); pattern 1 is already assigned to it. Hold step 1 at (1,4), tap step 16 at (16,4) and release step 1. The footer reads Channel 1 length changed: channel 1 now loops steps 1 to 16, and its four drum steps stay lit.
steps.title: Give channel 1 sixteen steps

steps.caption: Tap channel 2 at (2,1) and assign pattern 2 at (2,2). Hold step 1, tap step 5 at (5,4) and release step 1. The footer reads Channel 2 length changed: channel 2 loops steps 1 to 5, and its three figure steps are lit.
steps.title: Give channel 2 five steps

steps.caption: Tap channel 1 at (1,1) and tap Play (1,8). The drum channel repeats every 16 steps and the figure every 5, so the figure's three notes slide across the drum hits. Both channels start together on step 1 and only start together again on step 81, 80 steps or 13 and a third seconds later, because 80 is the first step count that both 16 and 5 divide into. Look at the MIDI strip, "MIDI sent in this step": channel 1 plays MIDI 36 four times in every 16 steps and channel 2 plays MIDI 72 three times in every 5. Tap Play again to stop.
steps.title: Play 80 steps
